timingPolicy.authority: Diagnostic only on the current non-reference machine; performance thresholds do not select or reopen a wire.
timingPolicy.cold: The first construct-free inspection in a newly started native inventory process.
timingPolicy.warm: The following four inspections in the same process; report median and p95 without flushing the OS cache.
timingPolicy.interference: Close Durin editor/test processes and avoid concurrent builds or storage-heavy work; non-exclusive runs are diagnostic only.

workloads.description: Every Git-tracked .dasset and .dabulk reachable from the Engine and Sandbox project mounts.
Deterministic powers-of-four size and edit distribution used only for analytic scaling and isolated Git/LFS experiments.
One atomic tightly packed authored voxel payload per VolumeTexture.
Domain-owned authored Texture2D/TextureCube source payloads; projection is not current-corpus fact.

candidates.placement: generation-named DABK v1 companion in Git LFS
candidates.legacyRead: DAST v4 reader accepts exact DAST v4 and resolves DABK v1
candidates.rollback: previous package bytes and every companion named by that package
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: old package continues naming the old immutable companion until package replacement

candidates.boundary: new DAST v5 with an explicit metadata index section before EOF
candidates.placement: versioned LFS-backed companion indexed by package metadata
candidates.legacyRead: old reader rejects version 5 before section decoding
candidates.newRead: new reader dispatches v4/DABK v1 or v5/indexed companion by package version
candidates.rollback: canonical v4 resave plus reachable DABK v1 bytes retained for the rollback window
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: old package remains authoritative until the new package atomically replaces it

candidates.boundary: versioned outer envelope containing an exact bounded DAST logical stream and metadata trailer
candidates.placement: versioned LFS-backed companion indexed by the envelope trailer
candidates.sourceControl: envelope ordinary Git; companion Git LFS
candidates.legacyRead: old reader rejects the envelope magic; it never interprets trailer bytes as DAST v4
candidates.newRead: new reader bounds and dispatches the inner DAST stream then validates the trailer/footer
candidates.rollback: extract exact inner DAST v4 bytes and retain every DABK v1 byte named by it
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: old envelope/package remains authoritative until whole-file replacement

candidates.boundary: new DAST version or outer envelope with package-local payload segment
candidates.sourceControl: .dasset would require an explicit ordinary-Git or LFS migration decision
candidates.legacyRead: old reader rejects the new boundary
candidates.newRead: new reader validates bounded object and payload regions
candidates.rollback: canonical v4 plus reconstructed DABK v1 companion
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: whole old file remains authoritative until replacement

candidates.legacyRead: old reader rejects the new boundary
candidates.newRead: new reader discovers only a fully committed footer generation
candidates.rollback: previous generation must remain discoverable without trusting the latest footer
candidates.lastGoodGeneration: requires filesystem-proven atomic footer commit or redundant generation discovery
